message.content: {"note_claim": "The 16th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution authorizes Congress to levy an income tax.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The Congress shall have the power to lay and collect taxes on incomes, from whatever source derived, without apportionment among the several States, and without regard to any census or enumeration.", "reason": "The National Archives page reproduces the amendment's text granting Congress power to tax incomes and states it established Congress's right to impose a federal income tax."}

parsed.note_claim: The 16th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution authorizes Congress to levy an income tax.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Congress shall have the power to lay and collect taxes on incomes, from whatever source derived, without apportionment among the several States, and without regard to any census or enumeration.
parsed.reason: The National Archives page reproduces the amendment's text granting Congress power to tax incomes and states it established Congress's right to impose a federal income tax.
